headline: Seduta ampiamente positiva a Wall Street: HP Inc. +11,49% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Broadly positive session on Wall Street: HP Inc. +11.49% leads gainers

paragraphs: Nella seduta del 25 novembre 2026 l'S&P 500 ha chiuso con 370 societa' in rialzo, 128 in ribasso e 4 invariate, su 502 titoli monitorati. La variazione media dell'indice e' stata di +0,81%.
Settori con la variazione media migliore: Materials (+2,10%); Energy (+1,55%); Real Estate (+1,25%). Settori piu' debolli: Health Care (-0,18%); Information Technology (+0,45%); Utilities (+0,54%).

In cima alla seduta: HP Inc. (HPQ, +11,49%); Charter Communications (CHTR, +8,39%); Axon Enterprise (AXON, +7,43%). I rendimenti dei Treasury hanno esteso il loro calo in seguito a una serie di dati economici statunitensi, secondo il WSJ. U.S. stocks closed mixed on November 25, 2026, as the market grappled with conflicting forces in the technology sector. According to the Wall Street Journal, U.S. stocks remained mixed as the Nvidia and AI rout continued, while Bloomberg reported that gut-wrenching volatility gripped Wall Street as AI doubts crept in. The selloff in artificial intelligence stocks spilled into other markets, with Bloomberg noting that stocks meltdown extended into unlikely markets, sinking the carry trade. Treasury yields extended their fall following a flurry of U.S. economic data, according to the WSJ. Breadth remained solidly positive across the S&P 500, with 370 stocks advancing and 128 declining, though the Nasdaq-100 underperformed with only 57 gainers against 43 losers, reflecting the concentrated damage in technology.

Materials, Energy, and Real Estate led the session, with Materials stocks averaging a gain of 2.1 percent, Energy up 1.55 percent, and Real Estate advancing 1.25 percent. Among individual gainers, HP Inc. surged 11.49 percent, while Charter Communications climbed 8.39 percent. Axon Enterprise rose 7.43 percent and CDW Corporation gained 6.59 percent. Analog Devices advanced 6.44 percent, though tracked outlets reported no specific catalyst for the move. Expand Energy added 5.75 percent, Bunge Global rose 4.87 percent, and International Paper climbed 4.77 percent. Texas Instruments gained 4.55 percent, while Deere & Company advanced 4.44 percent despite weak earnings guidance, according to Barron's.

Technology and Health Care lagged, with the Technology sector posting a gain of just 0.04 percent and Health Care declining 0.17 percent. Lam Research fell 5.68 percent and Micron Technology dropped 4.53 percent, with Barron's reporting that memory plays would bear the brunt of AI pain. Oracle Corporation declined 5.13 percent, while Datadog fell 4.31 percent with no tracked catalyst reported. Nvidia slid 3.91 percent after S&P warned the company's credit rating could be cut over rising management and governance risk, according to CNBC. Applied Materials fell 3.89 percent, Constellation Energy dropped 3.9 percent, and Quanta Services declined 4.1 percent. markets_brief.prose_html: I mercati azionari asiatici hanno avanzato dopo il volatile trading statunitense guidato da preoccupazioni sull'intelligenza artificiale, mentre la banca centrale della Corea del Sud ha innalzato il suo tasso di riferimento al massimo in due anni insieme a una previsione di crescita rivista al rialzo. Nel frattempo, gli assicuratori sulla vita giapponesi stanno effettuando coperture a livelli record nei loro sforzi per sostenere lo yen, aggiungendo complessità alle dinamiche di intervento valutario nella regione.
markets_brief.prose_html_en: Asian equities advanced following volatile US trading driven by artificial intelligence concerns, with South Korea's central bank raising its benchmark rate to the highest level in two years alongside an upgraded growth forecast. Meanwhile, Japan's life insurers are hedging at record lows in their efforts to support the yen, adding complexity to currency intervention dynamics in the region.
